title: Explaining teacher adoption of AI through the technology acceptance model: a meta-analysis and systematic review
title_zh: 通过技术接受模型解释教师对人工智能的采纳：元分析与系统综述
abstract: Abstract The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in education has accelerated rapidly, yet the factors shaping teachers’ adoption of these technologies remain insufficiently understood. A growing body of empirical research applies the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) to examine how teachers integrate AI, focusing on perceived usefulness (PU), perceived ease of use (PEOU), and behavioral intention (BI). TAM was, however, originally developed for static, deterministic technologies, and AI differs in its opacity, adaptivity, and capacity to challenge professional roles and identity, raising the question of whether perceived usefulness and ease of use alone are sufficient to predict adoption intentions in this context. Following PRISMA guidelines, this study conducts a systematic review of 38 empirical studies ( $$N = 15{,}919$$ teachers across 19 countries) on teachers’ AI adoption, together with a meta-analysis of the subset reporting extractable bivariate correlations. A random-effects model (DerSimonian–Laird) is used to estimate the associations among PEOU, PU, and BI across $$k = 24$$ studies ( $$N = 11{,}768$$ ), while the full corpus is synthesised to identify contextual conditions shaping these relationships. Pooled correlations are positive and moderate to strong (PEOU–PU: $$r = 0.532$$ , 95% CI [0.410, 0.636]; PEOU–BI: $$r = 0.536$$ , 95% CI [0.435, 0.623]; PU–BI: $$r = 0.619$$ , 95% CI [0.511, 0.708]), and are robust to alternative variance estimators and to the inclusion of UTAUT studies under a construct-equivalence ruling. Heterogeneity is very high ( $$I^2 = 97.9\%$$ – $$98.6\%$$ ) and prediction intervals span from negative to near-unity values, indicating that these associations hold directionally but vary considerably across contexts in ways the core model does not represent. Egger’s regression indicates funnel asymmetry on all three associations; leave-one-out diagnostics attribute this asymmetry entirely to a single large-sample, low-effect study, and the asymmetry is not interpretable as evidence of publication bias under heterogeneity of this magnitude. The qualitative synthesis identifies five dimensions associated with variation in these relationships: AI literacy and trust as preconditions for usefulness judgments; a shift from functional to identity-based acceptance shaped by pedagogical beliefs and institutional norms; the role of sociocultural and institutional context; tool-specific adoption logics; and ethical risk calibration as a values-based gate on adoption decisions. These findings suggest that predicting teacher AI adoption intentions may require variables beyond the TAM core, and motivate the development of extended frameworks designed for the sociotechnical complexity of AI in education.
abstract_zh: 摘要：人工智能（AI）在教育中的整合已迅速加速，但塑造教师采纳这些技术的因素仍未得到充分理解。越来越多的实证研究采用技术接受模型（TAM）来考察教师如何整合AI，重点关注感知有用性（PU）、感知易用性（PEOU）和行为意向（BI）。然而，TAM最初是为静态、确定性技术设计的，而AI在透明度、适应性以及挑战专业角色和身份的能力方面存在差异，这引发了一个问题：在此背景下，单凭感知有用性和易用性是否足以预测采纳意向。遵循PRISMA指南，本研究对38项实证研究（共$$N = 15{,}919$$名教师，跨19个国家）进行系统综述，并对报告可提取双变量相关的子集进行元分析。使用随机效应模型（DerSimonian–Laird）估计$$k = 24$$项研究（$$N = 11{,}768$$）中PEOU、PU和BI之间的关联，同时对完整语料进行综合，以识别塑造这些关系的情境条件。合并相关系数为正且中等至强（PEOU–PU：$$r = 0.532$$，95% CI [0.410, 0.636]；PEOU–BI：$$r = 0.536$$，95% CI [0.435, 0.623]；PU–BI：$$r = 0.619$$，95% CI [0.511, 0.708]），并对替代方差估计器和在构念等价规则下纳入UTAUT研究均保持稳健。异质性极高（$$I^2 = 97.9\%$$–$$98.6\%$$），预测区间从负值到接近1，表明这些关联在方向上保持一致，但在不同情境中差异显著，核心模型未能体现。Egger回归显示三项关联均存在漏斗不对称；留一法诊断将不对称完全归因于单一大样本、低效应研究，且在如此高异质性下不被解释为发表偏倚。定性综合识别了五个维度与这些关系的变异相关：AI素养与信任作为有用性判断的前提；从功能性到基于身份的接受转变，受教学信念和制度规范影响；社会文化与制度背景的作用；工具特定的采纳逻辑；以及基于价值的伦理风险校准作为采纳决策的门槛。这些发现表明，预测教师AI采纳意向可能需要超出TAM核心的变量，并推动为教育中AI的社会技术复杂性设计的扩展框架的发展。
